chunk: Michael Miller was born on June 11, 2005, in Florida, where he spent most of his childhood. Growing up, Michael was fascinated by the art of stone carving and whittling, often spending hours in his backyard workshop, honing his skills and creating intricate sculptures. Despite his passion for the arts, Michael's parents, both entrepreneurs, encouraged him to pursue a more conventional career path.
